description: List all routes operated by an agency. Returns route IDs, short names, and descriptions. Use to enumerate an agency's full service before searching for a specific route. Get agencyId values from onebusaway_list_agencies.

agencyId.description: Agency ID (e.g. "1" for Metro Transit, "40" for Sound Transit). Use onebusaway_list_agencies to discover IDs.

name: onebusaway_list_routes_for_agency

count.description: Number of routes returned for this agency.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `agency_not_found`: Agency ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if the upstream capped the route list — some routes were omitted. This endpoint has no pagination to retrieve them.

notice.description: Guidance when no routes were found — verify the agency ID with onebusaway_list_agencies.

routes.description: All routes operated by this agency.

items.description: A transit route operated by this agency.

color.description: Route brand color hex (without #), or null.

id.description: Agency-prefixed route ID. Use with onebusaway_get_schedule_for_route or onebusaway_get_vehicles.

shortName.description: The number or short name displayed on vehicles.

url.description: Agency schedule page URL, or null.

title: List Routes for Agency
